denominator_contract.unit: One distinct player workflow defined by primary goal, action/input, observable result, applicable costs/restrictions, and meaningful failure or boundary conditions.
denominator_contract.partition_rule: Every current workflow has one stable ID and one primary-goal category. MECE applies to these rows, not to the yet-unproven completeness of the retail game inventory.
denominator_contract.expansion_rule: Add newly discovered workflows instead of merging distinct outcomes or freezing the denominator to protect a percentage.
denominator_contract.scope: Base Spore Space Stage. Galactic Adventures and community content are separately labeled; RF021 world decoration and RF061 editor connection remain reference-only under current user scope.
